# Smoothing-parameter uncertainty in CL2 {#sec-lambda}

CL2 treats the smoothing parameters as fixed. This section reports a curve-robust term for their
variability, added to CL2 for the REML fit and for the curve-blocked NCV fit (`lambda-correction/`).

*Construction.* With $\boldsymbol\rho = \log\boldsymbol\lambda$ (for REML also $\log\phi$), give each curve $g$ a weight
$w_g$ in the fitting criterion $C$. The implicit-function theorem gives the influence of curve $g$ on $\hat{\boldsymbol\rho}$,
$\mathbf d_g = -\mathbf H^{-1}(\mathbf s_g - \bar{\mathbf s})$, from the curve scores
$\mathbf s_g = \partial^2 C/\partial\boldsymbol\rho\,\partial w_g$ and the Hessian $\mathbf H$ of $C$ in $\boldsymbol\rho$ (REML
criterion with analytic curve scores; NCV criterion with curve blocks, analytic scores for Gaussian responses and
central differences in $\boldsymbol\rho$ for Poisson and binary responses, where a $\rho_k$ with curvature below $10^{-3}$ of
the largest is treated as fixed). The infinitesimal jackknife (IJ) over curves gives
$\hat{\mathbf V}_\rho = \sum_g \mathbf d_g\mathbf d_g^\top$, which enters the coefficient covariance as
$\mathbf J\hat{\mathbf V}_\rho\mathbf J^\top$ with $\mathbf J = \partial\hat{\boldsymbol\theta}/\partial\boldsymbol\rho$, on top of
CL2 (Bayesian form). Variants:

- "+ IJ": the term above; "+ IJ ×": with the first-order cross term between the coefficient and the
  smoothing-parameter influences of each curve (total curve influence);
- "+ OS": $\hat{\mathbf V}_\rho$ from a one-step leave-curve-out update of ρ̂ instead of the IJ; "+ JK": from the exact
  curve jackknife (refits with zero prior weights for one curve, warm start; REML only, reference);
- "jackknife refit": the exact curve jackknife of $\hat{\boldsymbol\theta}$ itself plus $\mathbf V_p - \mathbf V_e$ (REML only, reference);
- "+ mgcv J": mgcv's own first-order term $\mathbf J[\mathbf H^{-1}]_\rho\mathbf J^\top$ (model-based, not curve-robust);
  "+ mgcv Vc − Vp": mgcv's full smoothing-parameter correction $\mathbf V_c - \mathbf V_p$ (REML only);
- "λ fixed": CL2 of a refit with every smoothing parameter fixed at the cell's geometric-mean
  selected value, computed from the same replicates (a diagnostic, not an interval one can compute
  from one dataset).

*Runs.* REML: the 18 core cells at the default signal (family × error process × G), the study's
200 replicates, and all 130 plasmode cells with 200 replicates. NCV: the 6 Gaussian and 12 Poisson/binary
core cells at the default signal with 200 replicates, and the 130 plasmode cells with replicates 1–100.
Every run reproduces the study's estimates and CL2 standard errors on the same replicates (common random
numbers; `lambda-correction/summaries*/` `*-crn.csv`). z intervals throughout. For the REML runs SE/SD is the
root-mean-square estimated SE over the replicate SD; for the NCV runs, where the IJ inflation is heavy-tailed
over replicates, the median-based SE/SD is reported.

```{r lam-load}
LAM <- \(d, f) readr::read_csv(file.path("lambda-correction", d, f), show_col_types = FALSE)
pm_cells_lam <- read_summary("plasmode", "ncv-diag-cells") |>
  distinct(cell, app, truth, residual, flip, error, G) |>
  rename(p_error = error, p_G = G)
LC_S <- LAM("summaries", "lc-cells.csv") |> filter(crit == "z")
LC_P <- LAM("summaries-plasmode", "lcp-cells.csv") |> filter(crit == "z") |> left_join(pm_cells_lam, by = "cell")
NC_S <- bind_rows(LAM("summaries-ncv", "ncv-cells.csv"), LAM("summaries-ncvg", "ncv-cells.csv")) |> filter(crit == "z")
NC_P <- LAM("summaries-ncv-plasmode", "ncvp-cells.csv") |> filter(crit == "z") |> left_join(pm_cells_lam, by = "cell")
# the plasmode runs use the main design's cell ids
stopifnot(!anyNA(LC_P$app), all(LC_P$family == LC_P$app), all(LC_P$G == LC_P$p_G),
          !anyNA(NC_P$app), all(NC_P$family == NC_P$app), all(NC_P$G == NC_P$p_G))
LCT_S <- LAM("summaries", "lc-targeting.csv")
NCT_S <- bind_rows(LAM("summaries-ncv", "ncv-targeting.csv"), LAM("summaries-ncvg", "ncv-targeting.csv"))
dep_l <- \(e) if_else(e == "iid", "independent", "dependent")
LC_ARMS_W <- c(cl2 = "CL2", naive = "+ mgcv J", vc = "+ mgcv Vc − Vp", ij_lin = "+ IJ", ij_linx = "+ IJ ×", os_lin = "+ OS",
               jk_lin = "+ JK", jk_full = "jackknife refit", fix = "λ fixed")
NC_ARMS_W <- c(cl2 = "CL2", naive_mgcv = "+ mgcv J", ij_lin = "+ IJ", ij_linx = "+ IJ ×", fix = "λ fixed")
rel_to_cl2 <- \(d) d |>
  group_by(cell, estimand) |>
  mutate(width_rel = width / width[arm == "cl2"], score_rel = score / score[arm == "cl2"]) |>
  ungroup()
# REML, synthetic
lc_s <- LC_S |> filter(arm %in% names(LC_ARMS_W)) |> rel_to_cl2() |> mutate(dependence = dep_l(error))
lc_s_cov <- lc_s |>
  group_by(estimand, dependence, G, arm) |>
  summarise(v = mean(coverage), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(arm = factor(LC_ARMS_W[arm], LC_ARMS_W), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  arrange(arm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |>
  arrange(estimand, dependence, G)
save_tab(lc_s_cov, "lambda-reml-synthetic-coverage")
lc_s_ws <- lc_s |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  group_by(estimand, dependence, G, arm) |>
  summarise(q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), width = exp(mean(log(width_rel))), score = exp(mean(log(score_rel))),
            se_sd = mean(se_sd_ratio), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%.2f / %.3f / %.2f", width, score, se_sd), arm = factor(LC_ARMS_W[arm], LC_ARMS_W), estimand = label_estimand(estimand))
save_tab(lc_s_ws |> select(-v), "lambda-reml-synthetic-width-score")
lc_s_ws_w <- lc_s_ws |> select(estimand, dependence, G, arm, v) |> arrange(arm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |> arrange(estimand, dependence, G)
lcs <- \(a, col = "coverage", e = "beta", dep = "dependent", g = c(40, 100)) {
  d <- lc_s |> filter(arm == a, estimand == e, dependence == dep, G %in% g)
  if (col %in% c("width_rel", "score_rel")) exp(mean(log(d[[col]]))) else mean(d[[col]])
}
lct <- LCT_S |> mutate(dependence = dep_l(error)) |> group_by(arm, dependence, G) |>
  summarise(rho = mean(spearman), lo = min(spearman), hi = max(spearman), .groups = "drop")
lctv <- \(a, g, dep = "dependent", col = "rho") lct[[col]][lct$arm == a & lct$G == g & lct$dependence == dep]
# REML, plasmode (curve flips, attached residuals; per dataset, mean over truth x residual sources)
lc_p <- LC_P |> filter(arm %in% c("cl2", "naive", "vc", "ij_lin", "ij_linx"), flip == "curve", p_error == "attached") |>
  rel_to_cl2() |> mutate(G_label = if_else(G > 40, "all", "40"))
lc_p_tab <- lc_p |>
  filter(estimand == "beta") |>
  group_by(app, G_label, arm) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), score = exp(mean(log(score_rel))), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(v = if_else(arm == "cl2", sprintf("%.3f", coverage), sprintf("%.3f (%.2f)", coverage, score)),
         arm = factor(LC_ARMS_W[arm], LC_ARMS_W), app = label_app(app)) |>
  select(dataset = app, G = G_label, arm, v) |> arrange(arm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |> arrange(dataset, desc(G))
save_tab(lc_p_tab, "lambda-reml-plasmode-beta")
lc_p_gain <- lc_p |> filter(estimand == "beta") |> group_by(cell) |>
  summarise(gain = coverage[arm == "ij_lin"] - coverage[arm == "cl2"], score = score_rel[arm == "ij_lin"], .groups = "drop")
# NCV, synthetic (Gaussian, Poisson, binary)
nc_s <- NC_S |> filter(arm %in% names(NC_ARMS_W)) |> rel_to_cl2() |> mutate(dependence = dep_l(error)) |>
  group_by(family, estimand, dependence, G, arm) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), width = exp(mean(log(width_rel))),
            score = exp(mean(log(score_rel))), se_sd = mean(se_sd_median), .groups = "drop")
save_tab(nc_s, "lambda-ncv-synthetic")
nc_s_tab <- nc_s |>
  filter(estimand == "beta", dependence == "dependent") |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%.3f (%.2f) %.2f / %.2f", coverage, q05, width, se_sd), arm = factor(NC_ARMS_W[arm], NC_ARMS_W),
         family = label_family(family)) |>
  select(family, G, arm, v) |> arrange(arm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |> arrange(family, G)
ncs <- \(fam, a, col = "coverage", g = c(40, 100), e = "beta", dep = "dependent")
  nc_s[[col]][nc_s$family %in% fam & nc_s$arm == a & nc_s$G %in% g & nc_s$estimand == e & nc_s$dependence == dep]
nct <- NCT_S |> filter(error != "iid", arm == "ij_lin")
# NCV, plasmode
nc_p <- NC_P |> filter(arm %in% c("cl2", "naive_mgcv", "ij_lin", "ij_linx"), flip == "curve", p_error == "attached") |>
  rel_to_cl2() |> mutate(G_label = if_else(G > 40, "all", "40"))
nc_p_tab <- nc_p |>
  filter(estimand == "beta", G_label == "all") |>
  group_by(app, arm) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), se_sd = mean(se_sd_median), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%.3f (%.2f) %.2f", coverage, q05, se_sd), arm = factor(NC_ARMS_W[arm], NC_ARMS_W), app = label_app(app)) |>
  select(dataset = app, arm, v) |> arrange(arm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |> arrange(dataset)
save_tab(nc_p_tab, "lambda-ncv-plasmode-beta")
ncp <- \(a, col = "coverage", r = APP_COUNTED) nc_p |> filter(estimand == "beta", G_label == "all", arm == a, app %in% r) |>
  group_by(app) |> summarise(v = mean(.data[[col]]), .groups = "drop") |> pull(v)
```

```{r fig-lambda}
#| fig-cap: "Coverage of β(s,t) with the curve-robust smoothing-parameter term (+ IJ) against CL2 alone, per cell, for the REML fit (left) and the curve-blocked NCV fit (right); synthetic core cells at the default signal (colour = family, open = independent errors) and plasmode cells (curve flips, attached residuals; black, G = all and 40). Dashed: no change; dotted: nominal 0.95."
#| fig-height: 3.8
d_fig <- bind_rows(
  lc_s |> filter(estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("cl2", "ij_lin")) |> transmute(fit = "REML", data = "synthetic", cell = as.character(cell), family, dependence, arm, coverage),
  lc_p |> filter(estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("cl2", "ij_lin")) |> transmute(fit = "REML", data = "plasmode", cell = as.character(cell), family = "plasmode", dependence = "dependent", arm, coverage),
  NC_S |> filter(estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("cl2", "ij_lin")) |> transmute(fit = "NCV", data = "synthetic", cell = as.character(cell), family, dependence = dep_l(error), arm, coverage),
  nc_p |> filter(estimand == "beta", arm %in% c("cl2", "ij_lin")) |> transmute(fit = "NCV", data = "plasmode", cell = as.character(cell), family = "plasmode", dependence = "dependent", arm, coverage)
) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = coverage) |>
  mutate(fit = factor(fit, c("REML", "NCV")), family = factor(c(FAMILY_LABELS, plasmode = "plasmode")[family], c(FAMILY_LABELS[c("gaussian", "poisson", "binomial")], "plasmode")))
fig <- ggplot(d_fig, aes(cl2, ij_lin, colour = family, shape = dependence)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~fit) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Gaussian = "#E69F00", Poisson = "#56B4E9", binary = "#CC79A7", plasmode = "#000000"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(dependent = 16, independent = 1), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "coverage of beta, CL2", y = "coverage of beta, CL2 + IJ term") +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "lambda-term-coverage", 6.5, 3.8)
fig
```

**REML.** In the dependent core cells the IJ term raises REML + CL2's coverage of β from
`r f(lcs("cl2", g = 40))` to `r f(lcs("ij_lin", g = 40))` at G = 40 and from `r f(lcs("cl2", g = 100))` to
`r f(lcs("ij_lin", g = 100))` at G = 100, at `r f(lcs("ij_lin", "width_rel", g = 40), 2)` and
`r f(lcs("ij_lin", "width_rel", g = 100), 2)` times the width; the interval score changes by a factor
`r f(lcs("ij_lin", "score_rel", g = 40), 3)` and `r f(lcs("ij_lin", "score_rel", g = 100), 3)` (@tbl-lam-reml,
@tbl-lam-reml-ws). mgcv's own terms add less (`r f(lcs("naive", g = 40))` and `r f(lcs("vc", g = 40))` at
G = 40); the exact curve jackknife of the smoothing parameters gives `r f(lcs("jk_lin", g = 40))`, and the
full jackknife refit overcovers (`r f(lcs("jk_full", g = 40))`). Fixing λ at the cell's geometric-mean REML
value covers `r f(lcs("fix", g = 40))` at `r f(lcs("fix", "width_rel", g = 40), 2)` times CL2's width
(interval score `r f(lcs("fix", "score_rel", g = 40), 3)` times): CL2's shortfall comes from which λ REML
selects in a replicate. The added width does not go where CL2 misses: within cells, the rank correlation
between a replicate's SE inflation and CL2's share of missed grid points in that replicate is
`r f(lctv("ij_lin", 40), 2)` (G = 40) and `r f(lctv("ij_lin", 100), 2)` (G = 100) under dependent errors
(`r f(lctv("ij_lin", 40, "independent"), 2)` and `r f(lctv("ij_lin", 100, "independent"), 2)` under independent
errors; `lambda-correction/summaries/lc-targeting.csv`). On the plasmode cells the term raises β coverage by
`r rng_pp(lc_p_gain$gain)` per cell at interval-score ratios `r rng(lc_p_gain$score, 2)` (@tbl-lam-reml-pm).

**NCV.** For the curve-blocked NCV fit the term brings β coverage in the dependent synthetic cells to nominal:
Gaussian `r rng(ncs("gaussian", "cl2"))` → `r rng(ncs("gaussian", "ij_lin"))`, Poisson `r rng(ncs("poisson", "cl2"))` →
`r rng(ncs("poisson", "ij_lin"))`, the same as the λ-fixed diagnostic (`r rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "fix"))`), at
`r rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "ij_lin", "width"), 2)` times the width (@tbl-lam-ncv). The median SE/SD moves only from
`r rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "cl2", "se_sd"), 2)` to `r rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "ij_lin", "se_sd"), 2)`: the
inflation is concentrated in a few replicates, and it is larger where CL2 misses more (within-cell rank correlation of
SE inflation and missed share under dependent errors `r rng(nct$spearman, 2)`). mgcv's term gives
`r rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "naive_mgcv"))`. For binary responses at G = 40 the term reaches
`r f(ncs("binomial", "ij_lin", g = 40))` (`r f(ncs("binomial", "ij_linx", g = 40))` with the cross term) from
`r f(ncs("binomial", "cl2", g = 40))`, and the λ-fixed refit covers only `r f(ncs("binomial", "fix", g = 40))`: the selected
smoothing parameters jump between interior and boundary solutions (`lambda-correction/summaries-ncvg/ncv-boundary.csv`).
On the counted plasmode datasets (G = all) the term raises β coverage from `r rng(ncp("cl2"))` to `r rng(ncp("ij_lin"))` per
dataset (stress tests `r rng(ncp("cl2", r = APP_STRESS))` → `r rng(ncp("ij_lin", r = APP_STRESS))`), median SE/SD
`r rng(ncp("cl2", "se_sd_median"), 2)` → `r rng(ncp("ij_lin", "se_sd_median"), 2)` (@tbl-lam-ncv-pm); the smoothing bias
of the NCV fit on these data remains (@sec-ncv-intervals, @tbl-ncvi-pm). Computing times are in @sec-timing.

#| label: tbl-lam-reml
#| tbl-cap: "Smoothing-parameter terms for REML + CL2, synthetic core cells at the default signal (three families × error processes): coverage per estimand, dependence and G (mean over cells)."
show(lc_s_cov, digits = 3)
```

show(lc_s_ws_w)
```

show(nc_s_tab)
